x: A Club Record in the Senior Shot for Joanne Hilliard and in the Inter 1500m by Jenny Webb and good to see Rosemary Honeychurch back to form after a mysterious virus.

Born in New Zealand on 1st March 1962 Joanne Hilliard moved to the U.K. at the age of 7. She became interested in athletics and started competing at club level at the age of 16, starting as an all-rounder before progressing on to training specifically for the high jump
13 Club records confirms another season of improvement for a rapidly advancing Ladies Section with 3 Senior records to Joanne Hilliard.

We had 4 County Championship winners - Wendy Dunsford (Middlesex-Shot), Helen Kemp (Surrey-Shot), Joanne Hilliard (Kent-High Jump) and Charlotte Christou (Middlesex 2500m Walk) all these plus Cindy James (Silver Medal in the Middlesex Shot) represented their county's in the Inter County Championships.
